npc.saideh.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, my name is Saideh. Once this was the entry to the crypt of our heroes. One of the graves belongs to our beloved hero Dayyan. Nowadays it is not a good idea to visit this place.
npc.saideh.say_1: [EN]  I would like you to visit the grave of our beloved hero Dayyan. His remains have to be reburied, because a horde of ogres controls this place. Do you want to start this holy mission?
npc.saideh.say_2: [EN] Well, I appreciate that. Good luck!
npc.sam.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
npc.sam.multi_1: [EN] Thank you very much! This brings back good old memories! Please, as a reward, travel to Kazordoon and ask my old friend Kroox to provide you a special dwarven armor. ...
npc.sam.multi_2: [EN] I will mail him about you immediately. Just tell him, his old buddy Sam is sending you.
npc.sam.say_1: [EN] Oh, Gregor sent you? I see. It will be my pleasure to adorn your helmet. Please give me some time to finish it.
npc.sam.say_11: [EN] I can't believe it. Finally I will be rich! I could move to Edron and enjoy my retirement! But ... wait a minute! I will not start working without a contract! Are you willing to sign one?
npc.sam.say_12: [EN] Fine! Here is the contract. Please sign it. Talk to me about it again when you're done.
npc.sam.say_13: [EN] You don't have a signed contract.
npc.sam.say_14: [EN] Excellent! I will start working right away! Now that I am going to be rich, I will take the opportunity to tell some people what I REALLY think about them!
npc.sam.say_16: [EN] This deal sounded too good to be true anyway.
npc.sam.say_2: [EN] Just in time, |PLAYERNAME|. Your helmet is finished, I hope you like it.
npc.sam.say_3: [EN] Please have some patience, |PLAYERNAME|. Forging is hard work!
npc.sam.say_4: [EN] I think it's one of my masterpieces.
npc.sam.say_5: [EN] Sorry, but without the permission of Gregor I cannot help you with this matter.
npc.sam.say_6: [EN] What? Are you telling me you found my old adventurer's backpack that I lost years ago??
npc.sam.say_7: [EN] My offers are weapons, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.sam.say_8: [EN] What? You want to buy 2000 steel shields??
npc.sam.stdmod_1: [EN] Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sam.voice_1: [EN] Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sam.walkaway_msg_1: La revedere și vino din nou.
npc.sandomo.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Praise the gods, I bid you farewell.
npc.sandomo.multi_15: [EN]  of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my {books} for now or {trade} it for something else.
npc.sandomo.multi_16: [EN] We scouted some caves beneath the island which hold plenty of chalk to mix some good mortar. The entrances are not very far from here in fact. ...
npc.sandomo.multi_17: [EN] However, the entrances are somewhat... twisted. The entrance we had mapped to a certain cave one day, would lead to a completely different cave on the next. ...
npc.sandomo.multi_18: [EN] And even when emerging from one of the caves you never know where you are since its exits are just as deceptive. ...
npc.sandomo.multi_19: [EN] Once you gathered some chalk, you should also find gravel on the island. If you have a pick and a bucket, you should be able to collect enough fine gravel to mix some mortar. ...
npc.sandomo.multi_20: [EN] Do not forget to bring some buckets, if you are in short supply, brother Maun will hand some out to you - for a fee of course.
npc.sandomo.multi_21: [EN] Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
npc.sandomo.multi_22: [EN] What we need is enough {mortar} to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
npc.sandomo.multi_23: [EN] Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
npc.sandomo.multi_24: [EN] Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
npc.sandomo.multi_3: [EN]  of righteously earned inquisition gold added. There. Thanks for your help! ..
npc.sandomo.multi_4: [EN] Good. Ask me any time in case you want to know your current {record}. If you have time, Remember you can also {trade} your earnings into some of these... probably far more valuable, ahem... cluster... things, yes.
npc.sandomo.multi_5: [EN] Of course, let's see. Hm, your recent endeavours would earn you
npc.sandomo.multi_6: [EN]  of righteous inquisition gold. You have earned
npc.sandomo.multi_8: [EN] Do you want me to add this amount to my books? This will reset your current records, too, however - so?
npc.sandomo.multi_9: [EN] Alright, so you mixed and delivered
npc.sandomo.say_1: [EN] You have {} inquisition gold registered in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_10: [EN] Brother Maun is a valuable member of the Inquisition. He will help you out with supplies. Provided you can actually compensate of course.
npc.sandomo.say_11: [EN] First, you will help us rebuilding this wretched {bridge} we cannot cross. We need mortar and there are several types of monsters who try to keep us away from it. ...
npc.sandomo.say_12: [EN] Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
npc.sandomo.say_13: [EN] Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
npc.sandomo.say_14: [EN] What we need is enough {mortar} to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
npc.sandomo.say_15: [EN] We scouted some caves beneath the island which hold plenty of chalk to mix some good mortar. The entrances are not very far from here in fact. ...
npc.sandomo.say_16: [EN] However, the entrances are somewhat... twisted. The entrance we had mapped to a certain cave one day, would lead to a completely different cave on the next. ...
npc.sandomo.say_17: [EN] And even when emerging from one of the caves you never know where you are since its exits are just as deceptive. ...
npc.sandomo.say_18: [EN] Once you gathered some chalk, you should also find gravel on the island. If you have a pick and a bucket, you should be able to collect enough fine gravel to mix some mortar. ...
npc.sandomo.say_19: [EN] Do not forget to bring some buckets, if you are in short supply, brother Maun will hand some out to you - for a fee of course.
npc.sandomo.say_2: [EN] Ah yes, you currently have {} of righteously earned inquisition gold in my book. 100 inquisition gold equals one cluster. How many clusters do you want in exchange?
npc.sandomo.say_20: [EN] Oh, so you want a reward, hm? Well... let's see. What did you do for us - helping Mortis with his {repairs} and defended him?
npc.sandomo.say_21: [EN] Alright, so you mixed and delivered {} mortar and ...
npc.sandomo.say_23: [EN] You also hunted {} silencers. That would equal {} of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my {books} for now or {trade} it for something else.
npc.sandomo.say_24: [EN] Come back after you have done at least one of the tasks I talked you about.
npc.sandomo.say_25: [EN] Of course, let's see. Hm, your recent endeavours would earn you {} of righteous inquisition gold. You have earned {} of gold in total. ...
npc.sandomo.say_26: [EN] Do you want me to add this amount to my books? This will reset your current records, too, however - so?
npc.sandomo.say_27: [EN] Good. Registered as... {}... with... about {} of righteously earned inquisition gold added. There. Thanks for your help! ..
npc.sandomo.say_28: [EN] Good. Ask me any time in case you want to know your current {record}. If you have time, Remember you can also {trade} your earnings into some of these... probably far more valuable, ahem... cluster... things, yes.
npc.sandomo.say_29: [EN] You have {} inquisition gold registered in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_3: [EN] You do not have enough inquisition gold for that, so far you can ask for up to {} clusters.
npc.sandomo.say_30: [EN] I do not see inquisition gold registered in my book from you.
npc.sandomo.say_31: [EN] Ah yes, you currently have {} of righteously earned inquisition gold in my book. 100 inquisition gold equals one cluster. How many clusters do you want in exchange?
npc.sandomo.say_32: [EN] You do not seem to have enough inquisition gold yet to trade for clusters, as it's registered in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_33: [EN] You should tell me a real number.
npc.sandomo.say_34: [EN] You do not have enough inquisition gold for that, so far you can ask for up to {} clusters.
npc.sandomo.say_35: [EN] There you are. Now I register {} inquisition gold of yours in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_36: [EN] Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
npc.sandomo.say_37: [EN] Brother Maun is a valuable member of the Inquisition. He will help you out with supplies. Provided you can actually compensate of course.
npc.sandomo.say_4: [EN] There you are. Now I register {} inquisition gold of yours in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_6: [EN] You do not seem to have enough inquisition gold yet to trade for clusters, as it's registered in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_7: [EN] You should tell me a real number.
npc.sandomo.say_9: [EN] Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
npc.sandra.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
npc.sandra.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, welcome to the fluid and potion {shop} of Edron.
npc.sandra.multi_1: [EN] The Edron academy has introduced a bonus system. Each time you deposit 100 vials without claiming the money for it, you will receive a lottery ticket. ...
npc.sandra.multi_2: [EN] Some of these lottery tickets will grant you a special potion belt accessory, if you bring the ticket to me. ...
npc.sandra.multi_3: [EN] If you join the bonus system now, I will ask you each time you are bringing back 100 or more vials to me whether you claim your deposit or rather want a lottery ticket. ...
npc.sandra.multi_4: [EN] Of course, you can leave or join the bonus system at any time by just asking me for the 'bonus'. ...
npc.sandra.multi_5: [EN] Would you like to join the bonus system now?
npc.sandra.say_1: [EN] We have a special offer right now for depositing vials. Are you interested in hearing it?
npc.sandra.say_10: [EN] Sorry, but you don't have your lottery ticket with you.
npc.sandra.say_11: [EN] Finally. You have no idea how difficult it is to keep something secret here. And you brought me all the crystal coins I demanded?
npc.sandra.say_2: [EN] Would you like to get a lottery ticket instead of the deposit for your vials?
npc.sandra.say_3: [EN] Are you here to claim a prize?
npc.sandra.say_4: [EN] Pssht, not that loud. So they have sent you to get... the stuff?
npc.sandra.say_5: [EN] What?? How dare you?! I am a sorcerer of the most reknown academy on the face of this world. Do you think some lousy pirates could scare me? Get lost! Now! I will have no further dealings with the likes of you!
npc.sandra.say_6: [EN] Great! I've signed you up for our bonus system. From now on, you will have the chance to win the potion belt addon!
npc.sandra.say_7: [EN] Alright, thank you very much! Here is your lottery ticket, good luck. Would you like to deposit more vials that way?
npc.sandra.say_8: [EN] Sorry, but you don't have 100 empty flasks or vials of the SAME kind and thus don't qualify for the lottery. Would you like to deposit the vials you have as usual and receive 5 gold per vial?
npc.sandra.say_9: [EN] Congratulations! Here, from now on you can wear our lovely potion belt as accessory.
npc.sandra.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.
npc.sandra.stdmod_1: [EN] Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.voice_1: [EN] Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.voice_2: [EN] If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.
npc.sandra.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|, please come back soon.
npc.sane_mage.greet_msg_1: [EN] ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.
npc.sane_mage.multi_1: [EN] My experiments, my work - not at the moment, however. I'm on vacation. Trying to get away from it... it's all not right. Why... why am I doing this anyway.
npc.sane_mage.multi_2: [EN] NO! I should not talk like that, I just... I shouldn't. That's not even ME. I... I used to be MAD. A MAD SCIENTIST! THE BEST! THE... the... WORST! A SUPERLATIVE! Ah, nevermind.
npc.sane_mage.multi_3: [EN] Not... right now, though. I am currently... on {vacation}. {Vacation}, yes. All my experiments went wrong. WRONG. Everything. I tried everything but still.
npc.sane_mage.multi_4: [EN] It's always the same, the {fungus} grows, I am EXCITED and... well... WHAAAAAM! It just EXPLODES! It spreads, covers everything.
npc.sane_mage.multi_5: [EN] At least I have my trusty {servants} helping me to clean up. They do ALL the work. Removing ALL the slime. At least they're working as intended. I designed them, you know.
npc.sane_mage.multi_6: [EN] However, sometimes people come and just... DESTROY them! Destroy my work!! Why? Do those people help me removing the slime instead? NO! Not at all.
npc.sane_mage.multi_7: [EN] All they do is ruining my experiments, my perfect testing conditions. It makes me just FURIOUS! And boy do I get FURIOUS, I tell you.
npc.sane_mage.multi_8: [EN] All they do is ruining my experiments, my perfect testing conditions. It makes me just FURIOUS! And boy do I get FURIOUS, I tell you.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_1: [EN] Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_2: [EN] What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3: [EN] Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4: [EN] I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5: [EN] I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6: [EN] Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.
npc.sane_mage.voice_1: [EN] Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.voice_2: [EN] What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.voice_3: [EN] Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_2: [EN] Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_3: [EN] Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_4: [EN] Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_5: [EN] Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_6: [EN] Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
npc.santiago.multi_1: [EN] Here, take this fish which I've caught myself. Find it in your inventory, then 'Use' it to eat it. This will slowly refill your health. ...
npc.santiago.multi_2: [EN] By the way: If your hitpoints are below 150, you will regenerate back to 150 hitpoints after few seconds as long as you are not hungry, outside a protection zone and do not have a battle sign. {Easy}, yes?
npc.santiago.say_1: [EN] Oh, what's wrong? As I said, simply go to my house south of here and go upstairs. Then come back and we'll continue our chat.
npc.santiago.say_10: [EN] That's just great! Now you have more health points, can carry more stuff and walk faster. Talking about health, did you get {hurt} by those cockroaches?
npc.santiago.say_11: [EN] Really? You look fine to me, must have been just a scratch. Well, there are much more dangerous monsters than cockroaches out there. Take a look at your status bar. You have 155 Health right now. I'll show you something, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_12: [EN] This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_13: [EN] I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.santiago.say_14: [EN] Really?? She was looking for someone to help her. Maybe you could go and see her. She lives just to the east and down the mountain. So, thank you again and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_15: [EN] This is an important lesson from me - an experienced veteran fighter. Take this! Look at your status bar again. As you can see, you've lost health. Now I'll tell you how to heal that, {yes}?
npc.santiago.say_16: [EN] I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_17: [EN] I knew you'd get it right away. You can loot food from many creatures, such as deer and rabbits. You can find them in the forest nearby. By the way... have you seen {Zirella}?
npc.santiago.say_2: [EN] I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.say_3: [EN] I've forgotten to tell you something. Of course I need proof that you killed cockroaches. Please bring me at least 3 of their legs. Good luck!
npc.santiago.say_4: [EN] Great, please go to my house, just a few steps south of here. Upstairs in my room, you'll find a chest. You can keep what you find inside of it! Come back after you got it and greet me to talk to me again. {Yes}?
npc.santiago.say_5: [EN] Alright! Do you see the button called 'Quest Log'? There you can check the status of quests, like this one. {Bye} for now!
npc.santiago.say_6: [EN] Ah, no need to say anything, I can see it suits you perfectly. Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.say_7: [EN] Oh, you don't wear it properly yet. You need to drag and drop it from your bag to your armor slot. Here, let me show you again. Is it a little {clearer} now?
npc.santiago.say_8: [EN] Oh no, did you lose my coat? Well, lucky you, I have a spare one here. Don't lose it again! Now we're getting to the fun part, let's get you armed! Are you ready for some {action}?
npc.santiago.say_9: [EN] I knew I could count on you. Here, take this good and sturdy weapon in your hand. Then go back to my house and down the ladder. Good luck, and {bye} for now!
npc.santiago.voice_1: [EN] Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
npc.santiago.voice_3: [EN] Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
npc.santiago.voice_4: [EN] Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!
npc.santiago.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.sarina.greet_msg_1: Oh, te rog intră, |PLAYERNAME|. Cu ce ​​vă pot ajuta? Dacă aveți nevoie de echipament de aventură, cereți-mi un {trade}.
npc.sarina.say_1: Vrei să cumperi o minge de fotbal pentru 111 aur?
npc.sarina.sendtrade_msg_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. {Footballs} trebuie achiziționate separat.
npc.sarina.voice_1: [EN] General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!
npc.scott.voice_1: [EN] Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!
npc.scrutinon.greet_msg_1: [EN] |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
npc.scrutinon.multi_1: [EN] He travelled on the very ground to reach the hostile shores of Quirefang. He used something that turned the soil and carved a way to the island. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_2: [EN] You will need to follow his trail if you want to reach it.
npc.scrutinon.multi_3: [EN] This island is cleft. Go there only prepared or you will meet your end. The surface of this forgotten rock is a barren wasteland full of hostile creatures. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_4: [EN] Its visage is covered with holes and tunnels in which its leggy inhabitants are hiding. Its bowels filled with the strangest creatures, waiting to feast on whatever dares to disturb their hive. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_5: [EN] And you will find no shelter in Quirefang's black depths, where the creatures of the deep are fulfilling a dark prophecy. ...
npc.scrutinon.multi_6: [EN] It is impossible to reach it by ship or boat. However, there was one before you. A {visitor} who found a way to enter the island.
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_2: Am dori să vă servim ceva timp.
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_3:
[EN] My name is Scrutinon. However, there are not many people calling my name nowadays. Not many captains even dare to land on this island. It is too close to {Quirefang}. ... \z
	Most of them do not know this island by that name. Some call it Demon Horn, others the Dragon's Tooth or the Gray Beach as none of them ever came closer than a fair distance. ... \z
	There are drifts and storms surrounding that place that are far too dangerous to navigate through even for the most versed captains. They often sail not closer than to this island here and drop off whoever dares to explore near this dreaded coast.
npc.sebastian.greet_msg_1: Salutări, aventurier îndrăzneț. Dacă aveți nevoie de un {passage}, anunțați-mă.
npc.sebastian.say_1: [EN] Do you want to sail Nargor for 50 gold coins?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_2: Am dori să vă servim ceva timp.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_3: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Nargor}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.greet_msg_1: Salutări, aventurier îndrăzneț. Dacă aveți nevoie de un {passage}, anunțați-mă.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_2: Am dori să vă servim ceva timp.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_3: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
npc.ser_tybald.greet_msg_1: Bine ai venit, copile. Ai venit să afli despre {magic}? Atunci ești în locul potrivit. Vă pot învăța multe {spells} utile.
npc.ser_tybald.say_1: Vrăjile sunt foarte utile în luptă - nu numai pentru magi, deși bineînțeles că ne bazăm în mod special pe ele pentru o mare parte din producția de daune. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: Ah, frumusețea lumii noastre! Este vast și extraordinar de divers. Insule ciudate, orașe frumoase și monștri fioroși care cutreieră pustii. Mistere, aventuri, pericol la fiecare colț. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: Odată ce ai atins nivelul 8, ești gata să alegi o vocație și să mergi pe continentul Tibian.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: Alegerea vocației tale îți va determina viața în Tibia și abilitățile și tehnicile de luptă pe care le poți folosi. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: Sunt patru vocații: cavaler, druid, paladin și vrăjitor. Dacă vrei să afli mai multe despre ei, vorbește cu Oressa în templu. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: Eu însumi predau vrăji de încercare pentru ambele clase de magie, în timp ce Tybald în camera alăturată este specializat în vrăji de cavaler și paladin.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: O fată foarte inteligentă. Preferă să asculte zgomotele animalelor sălbatice în loc de ale oamenilor, ceea ce este destul de înțeles când te gândești la asta. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: Cu toate acestea, ea este, de asemenea, o vindecătoare foarte aptă și vă poate oferi sfaturi cu privire la alegerea voastră a vocației.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: Există o mare varietate de ceea ce vrăjile pot face, după cum veți vedea pe măsură ce progresați mai departe. Următoarele vrăji le puteți cumpăra cu nivelul 8 și mai departe. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: Unele vrăji de atac pot fi direcționate către o singură țintă, în timp ce altele afectează o zonă, având efect fie în timp, fie instantaneu. Chiar și alte vrăji te protejează sau pot fi folosite pentru a crea rune. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: Fiecare vocație are propriile vrăji individuale pe care nici una dintre celelalte vocații nu le poate folosi. Poți învăța vrăji doar la un antrenor de vrăji al vocației tale. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: Vrăjile de aici pe Dawnport sunt doar pentru încercare și le vei uita odată ce îți vei alege vocația sigură și vei pleca în Continent. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: Acolo, poți merge la un profesor de vrăji dintr-un oraș pentru a învăța permanent o vrajă.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: Continentul oferă mult mai multe aventuri, pericole și căutări decât această mică insulă și are, de asemenea, profesori de vrăji unde poți învăța permanent o vrajă pentru vocația ta. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: Odată ce ajungi la nivelul 8, poți să-ți alegi vocația sigură și să pleci în Main. Du-te într-un oraș și caută antrenorul de vrăji al vocației tale pentru a învăța o vrajă. Și asigură-te că ai suficient aur! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: Arta predării vrăjii este complexă și periculoasă și vom împărtăși cunoștințele noastre valoroase despre o vrajă unui novice doar dacă acesta poate plăti prețul.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_1: [EN] In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_10: Aspru și înăsprit de tragediile vieții. Un om bun, dar sumbru.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11: Da, copile. Dacă vrei să înveți o vrajă, spune-mi.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12:
Un tânăr foarte încăpățânat, deși îi apreciez devotamentul față de meșteșugul de a face poțiuni. \z
		Fără respect pentru autoritatea superioară sau vârstă! Cu excepția poate pentru un mic punct slab pentru domnul Morris.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13:
Un tânăr ciudat. În mintea mea pare condus. Cu ce ​​forță, nu știu. \z
		Înțeleg că lumea are nevoie de aventurieri ca el.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14:
Să-ți mântuiești sufletul devenind funcționar? Nu foarte probabil. Odată pirat, mereu pirat. \z
		Dar el este un bătrân necinstitor fermecător.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15:
[EN] Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16:
Este priceput în artele marțiale. Un profesor foarte priceput de vrăji pentru cavaleri și paladini. \z
		Dacă aceasta este vocația ta, ar trebui să vorbești cu Ser Tybald.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17:
Ah, da. Din câte îmi amintesc, am călătorit mult cu Plunderpurse. Căpitanul Plunderpurse, atunci. \z
			Avea capul plin de cifre și statistici, băiatul ăla.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_2:
[EN] In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4:
[EN] I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6:
Nu ai ascultat? Sunt profesor de vrăji de druid și vrăjitor de la nivelul 8 la 18. \z
		Îi învăț tinerilor aventurieri vrăji pe care le pot folosi odată ce au vocația potrivită - druid sau vrăjitor.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_7: Am un vechi prieten acolo. Nu am mai auzit de el de ceva vreme.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8:
Oh, nu e prea rău aici, crede-mă. Cel puțin întotdeauna primesc discipoli tineri și entuziaști! \z
		Deși trebuie să mărturisesc că mi-e dor de vastitatea Câmpiilor Tibiene. <sighs>
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9:
Un bătrân vânător bun. Îi place să vadă viața tânără în jur, preluând căile și aranjamentele pământului. \z
		Dacă aveți întrebări, cereți ajutor lui Inigo.
npc.serafin.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
npc.serafin.say_1: [EN] Oh, no I don't sell cookies. Or, do you mean you'd like to give me one?
npc.serafin.say_2: Ar fi mai bine să pleci acum.
npc.serafin.say_3: [EN] COUGH?! What kind of a mean trick is that? Get out of my shop!
npc.serafin.stdmod_1: [EN] There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost.
npc.servant_sentry.greet_msg_1: [EN] The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
npc.servant_sentry.say_4: [EN] The. {Slime}. Has. Entered. Our. {Master}. Has. Left! We. Must. {Help}.
npc.servant_sentry.say_5: [EN] Defeat. {Slime}. We. Will. Why. Did. You. Kill. Us? Do. You. Want. To. Rectify. And. Help?
npc.servant_sentry.say_6: [EN] Then. Take. This. Gobbler. Always. Hungry. Eats. Slime. Fungus. Go.
npc.seymour.farewell_1: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.greet_1: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.say_1: [EN] Have you brought {0} dead rats to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.say_2: [EN] Hmmm, let me look at you. You got that intelligent sparkle in your eyes and you'd love to handle great power - that must be a future sorcerer!
npc.seymour.say_3: [EN] Hmmm, let me look at you. You have an aura of great wisdom and may have healing hands as well as a sense for the powers of nature - I think you're a natural born druid!
npc.seymour.say_4: [EN] Hmmm, let me look at you. You seem to have keen eyes and a steady hand - I bet you'd make an excellent paladin!
npc.seymour.say_5: [EN] Hmmm, let me look at you. Strong and sturdy, with a determined look in your eyes - no doubt the knight profession would be suited for you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_1: [EN] Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.stdmod_10: [EN] Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_100: [EN] Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
npc.seymour.stdmod_101: [EN] A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_102: [EN] Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
npc.seymour.stdmod_103: [EN] In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_11: [EN] HEY! You don't have so many!
npc.seymour.stdmod_12: [EN] Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_13: [EN] Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.stdmod_14: [EN] Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_15: [EN] HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_16: [EN] Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_17: [EN] Do you have a suitable present box for me?
npc.seymour.stdmod_18: [EN] THANK YOU! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.
npc.seymour.stdmod_19: [EN] HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_2: [EN] Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_20: [EN] Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
npc.seymour.stdmod_21: [EN] You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
npc.seymour.stdmod_22: [EN] For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young lady!
npc.seymour.stdmod_23: [EN] For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young man!
npc.seymour.stdmod_24: [EN] This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_25: [EN] It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
npc.seymour.stdmod_26: [EN] My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
npc.seymour.stdmod_27: [EN] At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_28: [EN] I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
npc.seymour.stdmod_29: [EN] Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_3: [EN] Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.stdmod_30: [EN] In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
npc.seymour.stdmod_31: [EN] Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
npc.seymour.stdmod_32: [EN] Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: [EN] Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: [EN] Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: [EN] Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: [EN] The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: [EN] There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: [EN] Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: [EN] Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: [EN] Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: [EN] Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: [EN] Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: [EN] We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: [EN] The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: [EN] The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: [EN] Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: [EN] Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: [EN] You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: [EN] Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: [EN] One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: [EN] Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: [EN] The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: [EN] There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: [EN] Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: [EN] Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: [EN] Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: [EN] You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: [EN] You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: [EN] A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: [EN] You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: [EN] A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_6: [EN] Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_60: [EN] Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: [EN] The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_62: [EN] The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_63: [EN] A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_64: [EN] I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
npc.seymour.stdmod_65: [EN] Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_66: [EN] Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_67: [EN] Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
npc.seymour.stdmod_68: [EN] Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
npc.seymour.stdmod_69: [EN] Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
npc.seymour.stdmod_7: [EN] Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_70: [EN] Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
npc.seymour.stdmod_71: [EN] Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
npc.seymour.stdmod_72: [EN] Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_73: [EN] The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
npc.seymour.stdmod_74: [EN] The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
npc.seymour.stdmod_75: [EN] The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_76: [EN] There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
npc.seymour.stdmod_77: [EN] You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_78: [EN] You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: [EN] The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_8: [EN] Only nonsense on your mind, eh?
npc.seymour.stdmod_80: [EN] Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
npc.seymour.stdmod_81: [EN] The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_82: [EN] To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_83: [EN] I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_84: [EN] Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_85: [EN] Shall I try and take a guess at your destiny?
npc.seymour.stdmod_86: [EN] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a sorcerer in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_87: [EN] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a druid in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_88: [EN] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a paladin in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_89: [EN] Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a knight in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_9: [EN] Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_90: [EN] Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
npc.seymour.stdmod_91: [EN] Norma has recently opened a bar here meaning she sells drinks and snacks. Nothing of importance to you, young student.
npc.seymour.stdmod_92: [EN] Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
npc.seymour.stdmod_93: [EN] A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
npc.seymour.stdmod_94: [EN] This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_95: [EN] Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_96: [EN] A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
npc.seymour.stdmod_97: [EN] Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_98: [EN] Willie is a fine farmer, although he is short-tempered. He sells and buys {food}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_99: [EN] A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.
npc.seymour.voice_1: [EN] Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.voice_2: [EN] Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.voice_3: [EN] Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.voice_4: [EN] Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.shanar.voice_1: [EN] Fine elven armor and weapons. Have a look.
npc.shanar.voice_2: [EN] Looking for protective spells for druids? I can teach you.
npc.shauna.multi_2: [EN] I think he was some guy from Darama. Can't remember his name. ...
npc.shauna.multi_3: [EN] He was here just for one night, because he got drunk and annoyed our citizens. ...
npc.shauna.multi_4: [EN] Obviously he wasn't pleased with this place, because he headed for Thais the next day. ...
npc.shauna.multi_5: [EN] Something tells me that he won't stay out of trouble for too long.
npc.shauna.multi_6: [EN] Oh, there's a waterpipe in one of my cells? ...
npc.shauna.multi_7: [EN] I guess my last {prisoner} forgot it there.
npc.shauna.say_1: [EN] What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.
npc.shauna.stdmod_10: [EN] The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
npc.shauna.stdmod_11: [EN] If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_12: [EN] If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_13: [EN] If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_14: [EN] If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but don't waste my time.
npc.shauna.stdmod_15: [EN] The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.
npc.shauna.stdmod_16: [EN] Our people are fine and peaceful.
npc.shauna.stdmod_17: [EN] I bet they spy on us... not my business, however.
npc.shauna.stdmod_18: [EN] I scared this bigmouth so much that he left the town by night. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_19: [EN] The city is is a peaceful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.
npc.shauna.stdmod_20: [EN] He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.
npc.shauna.stdmod_21: [EN] Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
npc.shauna.stdmod_22: [EN] Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.
npc.shauna.stdmod_23: [EN] Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
npc.shauna.stdmod_24: [EN] Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.
npc.shauna.stdmod_25: [EN] She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.
npc.shauna.stdmod_26: [EN] Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.
npc.shauna.stdmod_28: [EN] For me, he's the god of justice.
npc.shauna.stdmod_29: [EN] His cult is forbidden in our town.
npc.shauna.stdmod_30: [EN] Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_31: [EN] I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_32: [EN] Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_33: [EN] The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_34: [EN] For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.
npc.shauna.stdmod_5: [EN] Would you like to buy the general key to the town?
npc.shauna.stdmod_6: [EN] Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!
npc.shauna.stdmod_7: [EN] If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
npc.shauna.stdmod_8: [EN] If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.
npc.shauna.stdmod_9: [EN] The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.
npc.sherry_mcronald.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Grace our home with another visit soon, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.sherry_mcronald.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Welcome to our humble farm.
npc.sherry_mcronald.voice_1: [EN] Isn't this a beautiful day? Perfect for farming.
npc.shiantis.greet_msg_1: Oh, te rog intră, |PLAYERNAME|. Cu ce ​​vă pot ajuta? Dacă aveți nevoie de echipament de aventură, cereți-mi un {trade}.
npc.shiantis.say_1: Vrei să cumperi o minge de fotbal pentru 111 aur?
npc.shiantis.voice_1: [EN] Containers, decoration and general goods, all here!
npc.shimun.say_1: [EN] Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.shimun.say_2: [EN] Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
npc.shimun.say_4: [EN] Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.shimun.say_5: [EN] Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.shiriel.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.shirith.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a key for 50 gold?
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.greet_: Bună luptător. Presupun că ești aici pentru a {fight} pentru nobilul nostru {cause}.
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.say_1: Permitem campionilor capabili din toate rasele să lupte pentru cauza noastră împotriva provocărilor lui {arena}. Deci te intereseaza? Nu mă interesează jocurile de cuvinte fanteziste, așa că un simplu {yes} sau {no} va fi suficient!
npc.shirtalis_of_the_summer_court.say_4: Acest loc a fost întotdeauna un loc în care campionii verii și iernii s-au ciocnit în luptă. De-a lungul secolelor, acest spectacol a atras aici multe creaturi să privească, să participe și să se deda cu activități mai puțin savuroase.
npc.shoddy_beggar.greet_msg_1: [EN] What do you want? Listen to the old madman? If you have nothing to spare, leave me alone.
npc.shoddy_beggar.no_money_pre: [EN] Is that all you have? That would be less than I have... *mumbles*
npc.shoddy_beggar.no_money_quest: [EN] Mh, it seems you don't have any coins.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_1: [EN] Hmm, if you can spare a coin... we can talk. What do you say?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_10: [EN] Pah!! You have NO idea, leave me alone now.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_11: [EN] Right... I'm glad everything was destroyed. I don't even know why I kept the remaining copy of the plans all those years... oh, did I say this aloud?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_12: [EN] Yes, well... I do have one remaining copy of the plans. I will keep them as a... reminder. Such ill-fated devices only cause trouble and despair. Mankind would be better off, without them, right?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_13: [EN] Ah, you think you are wise but you know nothing, nothing about science, nothing about the opportunities it offers... You will never understand scientists like me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_14: [EN] Well, to be honest, I envy him a little. He can continue his research in his laboratory. He still has working equipment... I sometimes read his publications. He is an able man, but completely on the wrong track... give these plans to him.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_15: [EN] Mean, heartless... go and leave me be.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_19: [EN] Yes and I, I... you mean what? Can't imagine? Well, then there is no purpose to continue telling you this story.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_2: [EN] Persistent little nuisance, aren't we? Well, I like your spirit so I will tell you a secret. I may not look the part but I was once a {scientist}. The academy seemed to not like my... attitude and never actually invited me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_21: [EN] Thought so. It means starting anew, without any home, money or goal in your life. However, it also opens up opportunities... don't you agree?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_22: [EN] No, no, you are right, I should have tried to rebuild it, I should have been more careful, I should... ah, why did I even tell you this.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_23: [EN] Phew... alright, it was nice talking to you.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_24: [EN] Hm, maybe you are right. You could give these plans to someone who might be able to finish this project. Someone who will not make the mistakes I made. Someone... hm, do you know the astronomer Spectulus?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_25: [EN] Hmm, if you can spare a coin... we can talk. What do you say?

npc.shoddy_beggar.say_28: [EN] Well, if that is all you can spare... better keep it.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_29: [EN] Alright, it seems you are serious about this. I will tell you about my device. Every night I looked up to the stars and wondered what worlds we would be able to find if we could just look where we wanted to. So... hey are you still listening?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_3: [EN] Indeed, I was one myself a long time ago. I may seem a little... distracted by now, but I was working on many important projects. I even created a device to... well, it will cost you another gold coin if you want me to tell you the whole story. You're in?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_30: [EN] Good, good. So eventually I found a way and invented a magic device I called the Lightboat. It was a large construction you could sit in and... well, judging by your looks you don't believe a word. Do you want to hear the story or not?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_31: [EN] Fine. For years I gathered all the necessary items to build the device. I travelled, traded and took advantage of some rare opportunities. With luck and patience I eventually got every component I needed. Can you imagine the excitement I experienced?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_32: [EN] And there I stood before my greatest invention. Door to unknown places, mysterious worlds... yet one of my components was flawed. A small crack in a vital element of my construction quickly led to the failure of the whole project. Still following?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_33: [EN] The device was ultimately destroyed. I barely escaped the chaos with my life. My laboratory was shattered, as were all the components of the cursed device. With nothing left, I started to lead a new, different life. Do you know what that means?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_34: [EN] Pah!! You have NO idea, leave me alone now.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_35: [EN] Right... I'm glad everything was destroyed. I don't even know why I kept the remaining copy of the plans all those years... oh, did I say this aloud?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_36: [EN] Yes, well... I do have one remaining copy of the plans. I will keep them as a... reminder. Such ill-fated devices only cause trouble and despair. Mankind would be better off, without them, right?
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_37: [EN] Ah, you think you are wise but you know nothing, nothing about science, nothing about the opportunities it offers... You will never understand scientists like me.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_38: [EN] Well, to be honest, I envy him a little. He can continue his research in his laboratory. He still has working equipment... I sometimes read his publications. He is an able man, but completely on the wrong track... give these plans to him.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_39: [EN] Mean, heartless... go and leave me be.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_4: [EN] Well, if that is all you can spare... better keep it.
npc.shoddy_beggar.say_43: [EN] Yes and I, I... you mean what? Can't imagine? Well, then there is no purpose to continue telling you this story.

npc.shoddy_beggar.say_47: [EN] Phew... alright, it was nice talking to you.

npc.shoddy_beggar.thanks_pre: [EN] Very kind indeed. Maybe you are not such a bad guy after all. Maybe I can even give it back to you one day... you know I was not always like that *mumbles*.
npc.shoddy_beggar.thanks_quest: [EN] Thank you very much... plans you say? I don't know what you are talking about. Plans for a magic... device? And the people call ME crazy.
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_2: [EN] That astronomer of the academy simply has no idea what he is dealing with...
npc.shoddy_beggar.voice_3: [EN] Some secrets should better be left uncovered.
npc.sholley.multi_1: [EN] A transporter dead? This is more then alarming. It seems Harsin is up to something and whatever it is, it's nothing good at all. But not all is lost. A local medium, Barnabas, has truly the gift to speak to the dead. ...
npc.sholley.multi_2: [EN] I'll mark his home on your map. He should be able to get the information you need to locate Harsin.
npc.sholley.multi_3: [EN] So you have proven yourself a true friend of our city. It's hard to believe but I think your words only give substance to suspicions my heart had harboured since quite a while. ...
npc.sholley.multi_4: [EN] So Harsin is probably not the person he appeared to be. Actually I haven't heard from him for quite a while. He was resident in the local bed and breakfast hotel. You should be able to find him there or at least to learn about his whereabouts.
npc.sholley.say_1: [EN] Already clicked the body on the house Roswitha ?
npc.siestaar.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.siestaar.voice_1: [EN] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.siflind.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are in need of potions or magical equipment, just ask me about my {offers}.
npc.siflind.multi_1: [EN] I am pleased to hear that. On the isle of Tyrsung foreign hunters have set up camp. They are hunting the animals there with no mercy. We will haveto find something that distracts them from hunting ...
npc.siflind.multi_2: [EN] Take this jug here and travel to the jungle of Tiquanda. There you will find a race of wood eating ants called termites. Use the jug on one of their hills to catch some of them ...
npc.siflind.multi_3: [EN] Then find someone in Svargrond that brings you to Tyrsung. There, release the termites on the bottom of a mast in the hull of the hunters' ship. If you are done, report to me about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_1: [EN] I heard you have already helped our cause. Are you interested in another mission, even when it requires you to travel to a distant land?
npc.siflind.say_10: [EN] The next things needed are 2 fish fins. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_11: [EN] Do you have the 2 fish fins I requested?
npc.siflind.say_12: [EN] The last thing needed is a green dragon scale. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_13: [EN] Do you have the green dragon scale I requested?
npc.siflind.say_14: [EN] I have now no mission for you.
npc.siflind.say_15: [EN] Do you want to buy a jug for 1000 gold?
npc.siflind.say_17: [EN] Good! Now listen. To protect the animals there, we have to harm the profit of the hunters. Therefor, I ask you to ruin their best source of earnings. Are you willing to do that?
npc.siflind.say_18: [EN] So let's proceed. Take this vial of paint. Travel to Tyrsung again and ruin as many pelts of baby seals as possible before the paint runs dry or freezes. Then return here to report about your mission.
npc.siflind.say_2: [EN] Well done. The termites caused just the distraction that we needed. Are you ready for the next step of my plan?
npc.siflind.say_27: [EN] Thank you very much. This will help us to defend Svargrond. But I heard young Nilsor is in dire need of help. Please contact him immediately.
npc.siflind.say_29: [EN] You want to buy animal cure for 400 gold coins?
npc.siflind.say_3: [EN] You saved the lives of many innocent animals. Thank you very much. If you are looking for another mission, just ask me.
npc.siflind.say_32: [EN] You dont have enough of gold coins.
npc.siflind.say_4: [EN] Our warriors need a more potent yet more secure berserker elixir to fight our enemies. To brew it, I need several ingredients. The first things needed are 5 bat wings. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_5: [EN] Do you have the 5 bat wings I requested?
npc.siflind.say_6: [EN] The second things needed are 4 bear paws. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_7: [EN] Do you have the 4 bear paws I requested?
npc.siflind.say_8: [EN] The next things needed are 3 bonelord eyes. Bring them to me and Ill tell you the next ingredients we need.
npc.siflind.say_9: [EN] Do you have the 3 bonelord eyes I requested?
npc.sigurd.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the magic store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a trade if you need something.
npc.sigurd.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.sigurd.voice_1: [EN] Hiho adventurers, get your runes, potions, wands and rods here!
npc.simon_the_beggar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|. I am a poor man. Please help me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_1: [EN] That's great! I have stolen something from Dermot.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_10: [EN] Even if it worked on girls, I'd rather not be responsible for you ruining your pretty face. I have an idea though. If you help me brew one of these potions, I will sell something nice to you. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_11: [EN] I still have a pretty gypsy dress and a pearl necklace somewhere, which you could wear instead of this ragged skirt. For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces, it'd be yours. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_12: [EN] You only have to bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, so I can brew the potion. Do we have a deal?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_13: [EN] I can mix a secret potion which will increase your facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, it requires certain ingredients. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_14: [EN] For the small fee of 20000 gold pieces I will help you mix this potion. Just bring me 100 pieces of ape fur, which are necessary to create this potion. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_2: [EN] You can buy it for 200 gold. Do you want to buy it?
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_3: [EN] Well, it's the least you can do for those who live in dire poverty.
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_4: [EN] A single cookie is a bit less than I'd expected, but better than ... WHA ... WHAT??
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_5: [EN] MY BEARD! MY PRECIOUS BEARD! IT WILL TAKE AGES TO CLEAR IT OF THIS CONFETTI!
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_6: [EN] When I was wandering around in Tibia, I lost my favourite staff somewhere in the northern ruins in Edron. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_7: [EN] Uh, don't ask me what I was doing there... sort of a pilgrimage. Well anyway, if you could bring that staff back to me, I promise I'll give you my current one. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.multi_9: [EN] I can mix a secret potion which increases facial hair growth enormously. I call it 'Instabeard'. However, I fear it works only for men. ...
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_1: [EN] Haha, that beard is - well, not fake, but there's a trick behind it. I noticed people tend to be more generous towards a poor gramps. Want to know my trick?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_10: [EN] Ahh! Very good. I will start mixing the potion immediately. Come back later. Bye bye.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_13: Se pare că ai deja acest supliment, nu încerca să-mi batjocorești fiule!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_14: [EN] No, no. Our deal is finished, no complaining now, I don't have time all day. And no, you can't have my staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_15: [EN] I said, no! Or well - I have a suggestion to make. Will you listen?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_16: [EN] Good! Come back to me once you have retrieved my staff. Good luck.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_17: [EN] Did you bring my favourite staff??
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_18: [EN] Yes!! That's it! I'm so glad! Here, you can have my other one. Thanks!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_19: [EN] You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_2: [EN] Have you brought me the 100 pieces of ape fur and 20000 gold pieces?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_20: [EN] You do not have the staff.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_21: [EN] Sorry, but you need to have a premium account!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_22: [EN] Have you brought a cookie for the poor?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_23: [EN] I need gold. Can you spare 100 gold pieces for me?
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_24: Nu ai nicio prăjitură pe care mi-aș dori.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_25: [EN] You haven't got enough money for me.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_26: [EN] Thank you very much. Can you spare 500 more gold pieces for me? I will give you a nice hint.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_28: [EN] Pah! I said 200 gold. You don't have that much.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_29: [EN] Now you own the hot key.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_3: [EN] Hmm, I'm not done yet with your potion. But here, let me sprinkle a few drops of my own potion on your face... there you go. Now you just have to wait.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_4: [EN] Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_5: [EN] Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_6: [EN] Aha! I can see it! Now that you've waited patiently without shaving, your beard is perfect! All thanks to my, err, potion. Yes. Goodbye!
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_7: [EN] Hmm, it seems you need to wait a bit longer for the potion to take full effect. Please be patient.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_8: [EN] Oh, I'm sorry... I almost forgot! Okay, okay... here is your promised dress. I'm sure it will look so much better on you than on me- I mean, my, err, sister.
npc.simon_the_beggar.say_9: [EN] Great! Come back to me once you have the 100 pieces of ape fur and I'll do my part of the deal.
npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_2: [EN] Sir, Ma'am, have a gold coin to spare?
npc.simon_the_beggar.voice_3: [EN] I need help! Please help me!
npc.sinatuki.say_2: [EN] Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you and gives you five glimmering crystals>
npc.sinatuki.say_3: [EN] Jinuma, suvituka siq chuqua!! Nguraka, nguraka! <happily takes the food from you>

npc.sinclair.multi_1: [EN] We are still in need of more research concerning environmental as well as psychic ecto-magical influences. Besides more common ghosts we also need some of the harder to come by nightstalkers and - if you're really hardboiled - souleaters. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_10: [EN] Alright, the device is holding it. The magical barrier should be able to contain nearly 20 times the current load. That's a complete success! Spectulus, are you seeing this? We did it! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_11: [EN] Well, you did! You really helped us pulling this off. Thank you Lord Stalks! ...

npc.sinclair.multi_13: [EN] Excellent. Now we need to concentrate on testing that thing. The spirit cage has been calibrated based on some tests we made - as well as your recent findings over at the graveyard. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_14: [EN] Using the device on the remains of a ghost right after its defeat should capture it inside this trap. We could then transfer it into our spirit chamber which is in fact a magical barrier. ..

npc.sister_of_jack.greet_msg_1: [EN] Mh hello there. What can I do for you?
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_1: [EN] Yesss! So this time he will get it for a change! And he lived there...? He helped whom? Ha! He won't get away this time! What did he do there? I see... interesting! ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_2: [EN] Wait till mother hears that! Oh he will be in for a surprise, I can tell you that. Ma!! Maaaaa!!
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_3: [EN] I knew it! He likes taking extended walks outside, leaving all the cleaning to me - especially when he is working on this sculpture, this... 'thing' he tries to create. ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_4: [EN] What did he do? Since you look like a guy from the city, I bet he went to Edron in secrecy or something like that, didn't he? And you are here because of that?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_1: [EN] Why are you asking, he didn't get himself into something again did he?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_2: [EN] Spelltolust?! That sounds awfully nasty! What was he doing there - are you telling me he lived an alternate life and he didn't even tell {mother}?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_3: [EN] What?! And what did he do there? Who did he visit there?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_1: [EN] Where did I put my broom? Mother?

npc.spectulus.say_1: [EN] You are back, how did the measurements go? Did you recognise anything of interest?
npc.spectulus.say_10: [EN] Well, the only thing left to do would be to offer the crystal at the well of the collector. There must be a pedestal near the well, where you need to put your donation. Ha, do you think you could do that?
npc.spectulus.say_11: [EN] Found the well yet? Look on one of the ice isles near Carlin. I'm perfectly sure that the well with the pedestal is located on one of them. And be careful with the carrying device, I only have this one prototype.
npc.spectulus.say_12: [EN] So have you found the well and entered the lair? I hope you can find the {mirror crystal} in there. It is the only way to finish the {Lightboat}.
npc.spectulus.say_13: [EN] Put the mirror crystal into the special carrying device I gave you and bring it directly to me.

npc.spectulus.say_15: [EN] After the debacle with the crystal, I started focussing on other things. There are also some {tasks} that still need to be done. If you can spare the time to continue helping me, it shall not be to your disadvantage. So are you in for another mission?
npc.spectulus.say_16: [EN] So you found him? Have you talked to {Jack} yet?
npc.spectulus.say_17: [EN] You're back from {Jack}! Mh, by the looks of your face I doubt our little redecoration project yielded any success. But I had an even better idea while you were gone - ready to give it another try?
npc.spectulus.say_18: [EN] So, did you talk to his family? Were you able to convince them?
npc.spectulus.say_19: [EN] Did you find out what hobby {Jack} has? Did you separate him from this activity? Only if he has a free mind, he can truly get back to his former self! Now all you need to do is talk to him again!
npc.spectulus.say_2: [EN] Alright, you look bright enough to fulfil my requests - at least you do not fall asleep while standing there. Ahem... I heard about a certain inventor who created a {magic device} to actually sail the {sea of light}. Will you help me find him?

npc.spectulus.say_21: [EN] One remaining mirror crystal is in the hands of a creature called the collector which collects all kinds of crystals. The only way to get access to its lair is to donate a very rare crystal to a secret well. I need you to get one, will you help me?
npc.spectulus.say_22: [EN] Good, because if you wouldn't do it... listen, this well is on one of the isles near Carlin. There you offer the crystal. Once you get access to its lair, find the collector and... convince it to give you the mirror crystal. Understood?
npc.spectulus.say_23: [EN] To collect the unbelievably rare, practically unique mirror crystal, you will need to use this special carrying device I developed. If you find the crystal, use it to store it and transport it safely to me. There is no second one.
npc.spectulus.say_24: [EN] Of course you are. And here we go. I have to ask some questions first. One: You aint afraid of no ghost, right?
npc.spectulus.say_25: [EN] Good. Two: You know that ghosts exist and/or have found and/or defeated one or more of them?
npc.spectulus.say_26: [EN] Good. Take this wand - we call it a spirit meter - and go to the graveyard I have marked on your map and take a few measurements on the graves.

npc.spectulus.say_3: [EN] You should find the beggar somewhere in Edron. Stay persistent, I'm sure he knows more than he wants to tell us.
npc.spectulus.say_30: [EN] Yes, maybe it was the right decision. Astronomical research is nothing for the faint-hearted.
npc.spectulus.say_31: [EN] Well, the... what? You... mean you're no longer interested? I see, well maybe I overestimated your spirit after all.
npc.spectulus.say_32: [EN] Alright, alright. You'll never find out the true secrets of life with such attitude, hm.
npc.spectulus.say_33: [EN] Come on, this is our only chance to finish the Lightboat.

npc.spectulus.say_35: [EN] Come back if you made up your mind.
npc.spectulus.say_37: [EN] Then off you go! Im sorry that I cannot offer you any further help but Im sure you will find support along your way. And - be careful. The sea can appear pitch black down there.

npc.strange_pipe.multi_1: [EN] You will have to leave the plant through the eastern door on the lowest level. I have arranged for it to be 'accidentally' open. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_10: [EN] They seem to have supplied him with resources and workforce and a powerful {guardian} to prevent anyone from entering the passages to his lair.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_11: [EN] He is an old enemy of the city and I've battled him often in the past. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_12: [EN] Now he has returned for vengeance, he reclaimed an old abandoned underground {laboratory} and he has acquired new powerful {allies}.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_2: [EN] As in the past, our enemy still uses a series of machines to open the way to the next section of his lair. You have to turn them all on to proceed. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_3: [EN] They will only work for a certain amount of time though, so you will have to hurry or some of the machines will turn inactive again.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_4: [EN] While it's buried, it only uses his tentacles to attack. If one is destroyed it will simply use another set of tentacles and its supply seems endless. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_5: [EN] If you manage though to kill all the tentacles it is using within a few heartbeats, it will become confused by its momentary helplessness and will probably attack with its main body. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_6: [EN] That is when you have a chance to destroy it. Pass through its chamber and look for another of my tubes to contact me. Please hurry! End of communication.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_7: [EN] It's a fearsome subterranean beast like nothing I've ever encountered. It is dangerous and almost unbeatable because its main body is hidden beneath the ground ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_8: [EN] And it has an endless supply of tentacles. But not all is lost, as I have devised a {plan} to battle the beast.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_9: [EN] His allies are an enigma even to me. It seems they belong to some unknown race that lives deep under the earth. ...
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_1: [EN] I can't reveal much to you right now as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_2: [EN] I defeated him there in the past. It has been abandoned for many {years}, but I suspected him to return from the dead eventually, as he has done so often before.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_3: [EN] The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_4: [EN] I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.

npc.stricken_soul.greet_msg_1: [EN] This place is... haunted... heed my warning... there are... ghooooooosts here...! Why are you giving me that... look? I am certain, there aaaaaaare ghosts here - I've seen them! Do you believe me?
npc.stricken_soul.multi_2: [EN] . I will remember you. Now, lessons are every day in the morning and once a week in the evening... ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_3: [EN] Oh, you're not here for this, are you? So about the ghoooosts, yes. You seeeee, there are 3 secret passages here. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_4: [EN] Thiiiiis is no ordinary house... it is a nexus, a gateway to a once hidden cathedral. Sheltering a small and peaceful society of scholars and monks. Secluded from every distraction. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_5: [EN] I was one of them and ordered to hold contact to the outside woooorld. But then, something... happened. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_6: [EN] Outsiders managed to sneak in, infiltrate and influence the society... for the worse. Who knows for what ends. They chaaaaanged... ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_7: [EN] Shortly after, contact was lost... the nexus broken and sealed, ghosts appeared... eeeeeeeverywhere. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_8: [EN] Find the three passages... one is right here in the cellars, one in the jungles of Tiquanda and one in the deserts of Darama. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_9: [EN] Restore their connection and open this nexus to access the buried cathedral and find the cause to this... eliminate all remainders there if you must,
npc.stricken_soul.say_1: [EN] Excellent... I hope they will haaaaaaunt my house no longer. What was your... naaaaaame again, tell me?
npc.stricken_soul.say_10: [EN] Outsiders managed to sneak in, infiltrate and influence the society... for the worse. Who knows for what ends. They chaaaaanged... ...
npc.stricken_soul.say_11: [EN] Shortly after, contact was lost... the nexus broken and sealed, ghosts appeared... eeeeeeeverywhere. ...
npc.stricken_soul.say_12: [EN] Find the three passages... one is right here in the cellars, one in the jungles of Tiquanda and one in the deserts of Darama. ...
npc.stricken_soul.say_13: [EN] Restore their connection and open this nexus to access the buried cathedral and find the cause to this... eliminate all remainders there if you must, {}.
npc.stricken_soul.say_2: [EN] Yeeeees... you need to help meeeeeee. I want those ghosts gone... this is my home and I need it to teach my students. Will you take care of the... ghosts?
npc.stricken_soul.say_4: [EN] Excellent... I hope they will haaaaaaunt my house no longer. What was your... naaaaaame again, tell me?

npc.stutch.stdmod_1: [EN] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
